title: PES 0110 writes Text Transform text as an editable CEmbDText object
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes a text with a Text Transform as PE-DESIGN 11's CEmbDText: the CEmbNText record (letters, size, sewing, alignment, the click point) followed by the transform: PE-DESIGN's code for the preset, the default level's strength and, for the arches, the circle the text is bent round. The design is the compat text-transform-1 reference's: HHHHHHH in Lato Bold, size 10, centred on (50,50) mm, Fill at 5.0 line/mm without under sewing, in Red, with preset 1 (arch over). The reference check is PE-DESIGN opening the file with the text editable and the preset applied, and re-saving it.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, CEmbDText: the 26 compat/reference/text/text-transform-N files and the owner's round-4 captures of every preset at levels 0-100 on two other texts; the writer rewrites the 27 text-transform owner files byte-identical outside the documented differences (pes11.rs)

PE-DESIGN 11.50 opening a.pes (MANIFEST pes-0110-editable-text-transform, 2026-10-29): editable text, Transform preset 1 at the default level, retypable; the PES section re-saved unchanged but for the text box

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-editable-text-transform` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-editable-text-transform/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open), with Lato Bold installed as for the text references. Expected: the text HHHHHHH as an editable text object bent over an arch (Text Attributes > Transform ticked, the first preset, level as PE-DESIGN's default), Lato size 10, Fill Stitch red without under sewing, centred on (50,50) mm; compare its shape with compat/reference/text/text-transform-1.pes. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether it opens and with what warning, the preset and level PE-DESIGN shows, whether the text and the preset can be changed, the status-bar size and stitch count. Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json. If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11's Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 file signature
text-transform-1.pes: one text object, written as CEmbDText (the reader reports texts of both classes as CEmbNText)

internal regression: OpenStitch's own arch sews 79.9 mm. Known difference, open in docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md item 5: PE-DESIGN re-sews this object at 79.20 mm (its own text-transform-1: 79.30) round the same 40.8 mm circle; OpenStitch places the letters round the circle differently. Not compared at the reference tier until it matches at 0.3 mm
PE-DESIGN re-sews the arched text from the object: 26.50 mm
